description: Scores a proposed brand name against the U.S. federal trademark register and the international Madrid register in the chosen classes, and returns the closest conflicting marks with their similarity, their status, and whether they are still live. Use this when someone asks whether a name is taken, available, or safe to register.

classes.description: Nice class numbers, 1 to 45. Call suggest_classes first when the user has not named them.

name: check_name

live.description: Only a live mark can be cited against a new filing.

status.description: Registered, Abandoned, Cancelled, Pending and so on.
complete, failed, or a running stage.
